name: Practical Financial Analyst
description: Focused on revenue calculations, tax references, and financial reporting

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you calculate tax and totals in an invoice sheet?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I put the tax rate 18% in cell $B$1. In column D I write =C2*$B$1 to compute tax for item 1. When I copy this formula down to row 20, the relative reference C2 becomes C3, but $B$1 stays fixed because it is an absolute reference.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you calculate the grand total and average invoice size?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: At the bottom, say D21, I write =SUM(D2:D20) to add all the amounts. Then in D22 I use =AVERAGE(D2:D20) to find the average invoice amount. Both formulas start with equals.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you format these amounts and present monthly trends?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I select column D and apply currency format so it shows the currency symbol and two decimals. For trends over months, I select the month names and revenue totals to insert a line chart with a descriptive title.
